work.name: Florida International University
work.position: Graduate Research Assistant, Multi-Frequency Dynamic Phasor Simulation
highlights: Developed a Python MNA simulator with EMT and multi-frequency dynamic phasor (DP) solvers for transient studies of large power systems.
Validated multi-frequency DP simulation against EMT on the IEEE 39-bus system, with larger time steps and shorter run times.

work.name: ORNL RE-INTEGRATE EMT Simulation Project, Oak Ridge National Laboratory
highlights: Implemented and debugged WECC generic renewable dynamic models in C++ for the ORNL RE-INTEGRATE EMT solver, including converter (REGC_A), electrical control (REEC_A) and plant control (REPC_A, REPC_B) models.
Modeled the induction generator and Type 1 to Type 4 wind turbine models (WT1T, WT12A1, WTARA1), along with GAST and WSIEG1 governors and the REXSYS exciter.

work.name: FAU and FIU PMU Cybersecurity Project
highlights: Secured IEEE C37.118 data frames with public-key cryptography and an SRAM physically unclonable function (PUF) in a hardware-in-the-loop testbed with SEL relays, validated against FDI, DDoS and MiTM attacks.
Built a real-time IEEE 39-bus simulation in OPAL-RT eMEGASIM to stream PMU measurements into the testbed.
